name: Tianjin Jintou State-owned Urban Development Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Tianjin Realty Development (Group) Co., Ltd. operates as a property development enterprise across China. Its business scope also extends to the administration and operation of real estate holdings, the marketing of commercial residential units, the management of commercial assets, and the handling of building materials. The firm was established in 1981 and maintains its primary base of operations in Tianjin, China.
